question.prompt: A hot air balloon pilot carefully records the balloon's height above the ground, in metres, at the end of every minute as it gradually and steadily descends towards the landing field: 180, 165, 150, 135, and so on, always decreasing by 15 metres each time. If this exact pattern continues without changing for 6 more minutes beyond those already recorded, what will the balloon's recorded height be after the 7th minute of descent?

visuals.altText: Line graph of balloon height over the first four minutes: 180, 165, 150 and 135 metres.

question.explanation: Each recorded height is 15 metres less than the height recorded immediately before it, so the balloon descends at a steady rate of 15 metres every single minute. Starting from 180 metres at minute 1, reaching minute 7 requires 6 further minutes of steady descent. Multiplying 15 metres by those 6 minutes gives a total descent of 90 metres from the starting height. Subtracting 90 metres from 180 metres leaves a final height of 90 metres after the 7th minute.
